children: Fawry has partnered with software solutions provider DMS to connect Fawry business point-of-sale (POS) solutions directly with DMS’s medical management system, as per an emailed press release.

The integration allows hospitals and other organizations using DMS solutions to process payments through their existing operational systems. Transaction amounts are transferred automatically from cashier screens to Fawry Business POS devices, while payment status is updated within the system in real time.

By transferring data between the two systems automatically, the integration is designed to limit manual input and reduce data-entry errors. It also aims to accelerate payment and settlement procedures while keeping transaction records updated.

“Our collaboration with DMS represents a practical step toward connecting payments with business management systems, contributing to the automation of processes, reducing manual intervention, and improving the accuracy and speed of transactions across the healthcare sector and various business environments, in support of comprehensive digital transformation efforts,” Bassem Lotfy, Head of Business Development at Fawry, said.

Roaa Mamdouh, Strategic Alliances Director at DMS, commented: “Through our collaboration with Fawry Business, we enable our customers to connect payment processes directly with their operational management systems, allowing transaction data and status to move automatically between the system and the POS without the need for manual intervention. Through this partnership, we aim to provide practical solutions that respond to the needs of businesses and hospitals, while supporting their ability to manage daily operations with greater accuracy and efficiency.”
